word_method: UTF-8-sig decode then str.split whitespace words; include frontmatter

tokenizer.counts: unavailable: no verified installed compatible model tokenizer; no downloads attempted

claim_limits: Total applicable memory/lesson/workflow instruction closure for explicitly declared states, including recursively required and already-loaded workflow owners. Not measured model context, tool runtime or monetary cost. Host/global instructions, task messages/plan contents, platform invocation metadata and cross-skill domain/stack owners outside memory/lesson/workflow are excluded equally. No workflow-internal owner is excluded merely because its obligation was resolved earlier.

lesson_scenario_starting_state.plan: Existing admitted local resumable multi-phase plan and checkpoint; no JSON consumer or prompt pack.
lesson_scenario_starting_state.admission_profile_task_store: Previously resolved and still valid; their owners remain included in the inherited total.
lesson_scenario_starting_state.execution_handoff_bindings: Phase/task bindings previously populated and loaded; existing-plan resume reconciled canonical state.
lesson_scenario_starting_state.prior_memory: Hindsight memory was already activated for prior-context planning; selected routine adapter and router remain included in inherited total.
lesson_scenario_starting_state.boundary: First signal-bearing completed-phase intermediate scan after phase validation/source identity was recorded.
lesson_scenario_starting_state.results_recorded: Scan disposition is recorded in the existing plan and checkpoint, even when no candidates pass admission.
lesson_scenario_starting_state.effects: Local workflow evidence recording is authorized; admitted-write case additionally authorizes scoped durable publication. No Beads, prompt generation, Git integration, runtime allocation, whole-task completion or workflow review.

closure_conditions.ordinary_recall: Standalone memory trigger admitted; current approved Hindsight configuration resolved; routine query only; no active workflow.
closure_conditions.capability_recall: Standalone local miss about to block or unresolved-owner permitted repair; Hindsight existence/ownership query; no active workflow or further effects.
closure_conditions.no_admitted_lesson: Declared existing-plan lesson starting state; scan rejects all candidates before shaping/publication, but workflow disposition recording and inherited obligations remain.
closure_conditions.admitted_lesson_authorized_write: Same existing-plan starting state; scoped candidate passes admission, is shaped/parked and authorized for selected-store write; knowledge shape/dedup required.
closure_conditions.canonical_drift: Standalone current canonical sources disagree; no active workflow; selected-store pointer optional; repository drift owner required.
closure_conditions.adapter_setup: Standalone Hindsight setup/configuration/import/maintenance explicitly authorized; no active workflow.
